# The End of the Road

*Hollis can't leave his post, and he has always wanted to know what is at the far end of a road. Walk the World Tree Road to the Rootlands, where it ends at the Tree's foot, and clear 30 of the monsters there.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Hollis](../npcs/hollis.md) |
| Level | 14 |
| Leads to | [Stern, Then Smiling](../quests/hollis_stern_then_smiling.md) |

## Objectives

- Reach where the road ends in [The Rootlands](../maps/rootlands.md)
- Defeat 30 monsters in [The Rootlands](../maps/rootlands.md)

## Rewards

- 1,300 EXP
- 280 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x5
- +10 standing with Selsior
- +80 standing with [Hollis](../npcs/hollis.md)
